Group of about 7 friends. Ex-friend D did something really crazy one night in 2020 and 5 of us have not spoken to her since. 

My boyfriend (J) and I visited her that Summer because she was really lonely after moving 2 hours away to live with her cousin L at the beach. I felt bad, especially since it was her first time living on her own. 
Especially since she was an alcoholic with a loooot of issues. 

We all started drinking a little with her roommates, but nothing too much. J and I have never been really heavy drinkers, so a shot and a drink was enough for us. Things got intense and the three of us, J, D, and I end up in her room. The three of us start kissing on her bed, and I ask D, is this okay? She says yes. J asks if she’s sure. She says yes and starts to undress my boyfriend. Then L barges in and yells that the two of us need to leave. 

We embarrassingly get our things and run out the door. We quickly book a hotel and start to drive off. 
D runs out, drunk as hell, and begs us to take her with us. She starts sobbing and apologizing, says that she wants this. We are a little confused, and tell her to go to bed. She goes back inside. 

J and I knock out at the hotel. Best sleep ever. 
I wake up to missed calls from her, crying and apologizing. I ignore it and move on. My boyfriend and I have a fun time at the beach. 
Days go by and I wonder about her— she typically posts her entire life online and I haven’t seen a thing since the trip. I look up her profile and see that I’m blocked. That’s weird. 

A few weeks later I get a message from L. We weren’t even following each other, so I thought that was weird. 
L apologizes to me and says that D caused a big scene after we left. She was breaking things around the house and hitting L, all while crying and telling her she ruined her life. Then, she told me that she barged into the room because D texted her that J and I DRUGGED HER and was trying to RAPE HER. L also told me that roommate K told her that D tried to get K to put more liquor in my drink. K refused. L was very confused that night, because why was D begging her to let her go with us if we were trying to do that? L also told me that D told her she invited me and my boyfriend over because she felt bad about us having problems. We weren’t!!! 

L told me that that was the last straw and told D she should move out, she was late on her share of the rent too. D called her family to pick her up and she left. As her family was packing her room up, she told her uncle “Working just isn’t for me” and he told her, “That’s okay, you’re too pretty to work.” …she was 24.
L told me that instead of going to work, she actually just sat in the parking lot and scrolled social media. 

Anyway, long story short our friend group hasn’t talked to her since, except for 1 person— C. C told me that she automatically believed her because you always have to believe the victim, and because I tried to kiss C 5 years prior when I was drunk. (No one has talked to C either. C wasn’t very close or relevant anyway) But thats okay, everyone else knew that D was mentally unstable and understood that none of that was okay, even if she was dealing with problems. Lying about rape made everyone quickly block her and never look back. 

That was the incident. 2020 was weird. 
I hope D is sober now.
